title: dsamoht/clustermg pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

name.errorMessage: Assembly name must be provided and may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-': it prefixes every contig, gene and MAG id of the assembly

assembly.errorMessage: The assembly must be a FASTA file ('.fa', '.fasta' or '.fna', optionally gzipped) and its path cannot contain spaces

bins.errorMessage: The path to the bins directory cannot contain spaces

checkm2.errorMessage: The path to the CheckM2 quality report cannot contain spaces

errorMessage.dependentRequired: Bins need their CheckM2 quality report: provide both 'bins' and 'checkm2', or neither
